title: Citadel Hub
summary: A way for me to manage my digital estate, with API integration for external services. Hosted locally, and served via a dashboard.
body:
## Why I built it
I was sick of going to my council website every Wednesday evening to check which bins I was supposed to put out for collection, surely I could automate that? It escalated from there.

It uses a combination of external APIs and (polite!) web scraping, along with my Music Companion's SQL database, to tailor information to me and cut out the noise. 

The GitHub repo is currently private, while my secrets and API keys are .gitignored, I'm sill nervous about making this public without a thorough vetting. 

## How it works
Hosted locally on a linux server, and accessible from any device on my  network. It includes IP whitelisting so settings and sensitive information is only available from dedicated devices. Guest devices have access to a limited number of services. 

## What it contains
Dashboard:
- Google calendar integration
- Local services monitoring
- Upcoming music releases and vinyl pre-order tracking
- Gig radar of upcoming concerts
- System monitoring for temperatures and disk space
- A launchpad for all services
- Notification system for upcoming events, life admin, etc. 

Media server:
- Hosted on a JellyFin installation
- Digitised TV and Film library
- Extensive live concert selection

Music Companion:
- Fully integrated Music Companion
- See the project page for full details
